_readme: Illustrated scenes. Each sequence is a list of shots; a shot is an image (file in Art/Processed/cutscenes, empty = black card) and the lines spoken over it. 'Name[expression]: text' shows that person's portrait; a line without a name keeps the last speaker in that shot. Expressions: betty neutral/sad/angry/shocked, liam neutral/drunk/angry/shocked, ceo neutral/smug/stern/angry, donnie neutral/worried/angry/shocked. Kidnappers: Yuvie, Adi, Irshad. Adapted from the author's opening script.

lines: {music:betty_donnie}Betty: That's my family.
The best anyone could ask for. At least, that's what it used to look like.
Mum and Dad fell in love young. Neither family was thrilled about it.
Something about Dad not having much going for him, and Mum throwing away her future.
Honestly? I never cared. Life was perfect.
Mum was a software developer at Gyaracorp. Sam Raymond.
Dad stayed at home. Donald Raymond. He cooked, he cleaned, he walked me to school, he did pretty much everything else.
I thought that was normal. Other kids thought it was weird.
Betty[sad]: Then Mum died.
Everything changed after that.
Dad had spent years looking after me. Getting back into work wasn't exactly easy.
Gyaracorp offered him a job in the end. Partly because Mum had worked there for so long.
Not a fancy developer job. Just a janitor.
I didn't care. He was doing everything for me, and I love him for that.
Betty[angry]: My so-called friends at school found it a lot funnier than I did.
A dad who stays at home was weird. Now a dad who mops floors is a punchline
And I was the easiest joke in the room.
Betty: I usually take the same way to school.
But some days I couldn't face the jokes about my dad. So I'd take the long way round.
This was one of those days.
{music:the_people_upstairs}Elsewhere...
Liam: Another year. Another record profit. More contracts, more money, and more reasons for Dad to pat himself on the back.
Magicorp, meanwhile, is practically on life support. Because of us. Apparently that's a good thing.
Not that I care. I couldn't tell you what Gyaracorp actually does half the time.
But I can tell you exactly what I need.
A new car. Because I totalled the old one. No big deal.
Liam[angry]: I need that new car, Dad. I've been asking for weeks.
CEO[stern]: You crashed a practically new car, Liam.
Liam: Come on! I'm alright, aren't I?
CEO: I'm glad you're alright. I'm less glad you had it for six months before you wrapped it round a lamppost.
Do you have any idea what that costs?
Liam[angry]: Here we go. It's always about the money.
CEO: Because you're incapable of understanding what it's worth.
Liam: You just made a record profit! It's nothing to you.
CEO[angry]: It's something to me. Because you think every problem goes away if someone throws money at it.
Liam[shocked]: You're seriously refusing to buy your own son a car?
CEO[stern]: I'm refusing to buy you a THIRD car in the same year. Take the bus. Take a taxi. I don't care.
If you actually want something, show up at the office on Monday.
Liam: Why?
CEO: Work. I've spoken to the board. It's time you started learning the business, because one day this company will be yours...
Liam[angry]: Blah, blah, blah. Will I get the car or not? It's always about your stupid company.
CEO[angry]: I won't let you ruin what I've built. Either you work and buy the car yourself, or you can fuck off.
Liam[shocked]: Dad? ...He hung up on me.
Liam[angry]: I hate you, Dad. Keep your company.
Let's see how much you enjoy running it when things aren't going so well.
{music:the_usual_suspects}Betty[shocked]: LET GO!
Yuvie: Stop struggling!
Betty[shocked]: HELP! SOMEBODY!
Adi: Yuvie, careful! Don't hurt her.
Yuvie: Then tell her to stop kicking!
Irshad: Just cooperate, kid. We only need something from your daddy.
Betty[angry]: WHAT? What do you want from my dad?
Adi: We need... something from him.
Betty[angry]: Then go and TALK to him! Let me GO!
Irshad: ...That's actually not a bad idea.
Yuvie: Irshad, I swear to God. Throw her in the van before somebody comes.
Gyaracorp. Tuesday, 8:02 AM.
The kidnappers keep their word.
A van slows at the end of Betty's street. The door slides open, and then it drives away without her.
Betty[sad]: What is happening?
GyaraCorp needs somebody to blame for a burnt-out server room, and Donnie was standing right next to it.
The kidnappers are never found. Gyaracorp was troubled
But Donnie gets eight years with Betty visiting every Sunday.
The kidnappers saw through the lie. Ryker was their eyes all along.
Donnie had one query left in him. He used it to delete GyaraCorp.
It didn't bring her back.
GyaraCorp collapses within the month. Thirty years, gone in one DELETE.
Donnie doesn't resist the arrest. There's nothing left to resist for.
The kidnappers keep their side of the deal. Betty is dropped off at the end of her street.
Liam is arrested, still shouting a name nobody recognises.
GyaraCorp's data turns up in MagiCorp's systems. GyaraCorp's stock plummets. And MagiCorp's through the roof.
Donnie bought 4,096 shares at 83p. By Friday they're worth a little under nine hundred thousand pounds.
He hands in his notice by email. Donnie beats the capitalists at their own game.
{music:betty_donnie}The police raid an old print shop on Calder Street, behind the bus depot.
Betty is found safe. The three kidnappers are arrested on the spot. So is Liam, an hour later, in his father's office.
CEO: We are grateful Donald for your service. And since you're so skilled...
CEO: GyaraCorp could use a database engineer. Starting Monday. Proper job. Proper salary. What do you say?
Donnie: You don't have to sir
CEO: It's nothing Mr. Raymond. Take it.
Betty: Dad. Say yes.
